meta.title: Vendor e-mail when the buyer sends a reminder
gaps: Open the QA vendor mailboxes and verify that exactly the non-bidding vendor received one reminder email, the bidder and any real supplier received none, and the email content is correct.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the QA vendor mailboxes and verify that exactly the non-bidding vendor received one reminder email, the bidder and any real supplier received none, and the email content is correct.

steps.note: Start a buyer-side event for the reminder scenario.
Use an RFQ stage so vendors can submit bids.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding items.
Add one line item for the vendor quote.
Invite two QA vendors so one can bid and one can remain pending.
Make the event available to the invited vendors.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have one invited vendor bid, leaving the other vendor eligible for a reminder.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's reminder drawer to inspect the pending submission audience.
Confirm the reminder drawer is showing the offer-submission reminder flow.

args.goal: send the offer-submission reminder from the open Send Reminders drawer by pressing Notify, then stop when the screen shows the send confirmation

steps.note: Perform the buyer action that actually sends the reminder.

args.need: open the QA vendor mailboxes and verify that exactly the vendor who did not bid received one reminder-to-submit email, while the bidder and any real supplier received none

steps.note: Mailbox access and email-recipient/content verification are outside the catalog.
Confirm the Procol screen remains free of an application error after the mailbox verification step.
